description: AUTHORITATIVE for US Census geography: geocode a US street address to coordinates AND its full Census geography stack — state, county, census tract, census block, incorporated place, congressional district, school district, CBSA. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH whenever you need a GEOID or FIPS code to join an address to ACS, decennial-census, SAIPE or any other Census-keyed dataset. Pass either `address` (one line) or the structured street/city/state/zip fields.

address.description: Full address on one line, e.g. "1600 Pennsylvania Ave NW, Washington, DC 20500"

benchmark.description: Census benchmark, default Public_AR_Current. Must be consistent with `vintage`.

street.description: Street line, if geocoding structured parts instead of `address`

vintage.description: Geography vintage, default Current_Current (also: Census2020_Current, ACS2023_Current).

name: census_geocode_address
title: Census Geocode Address
